title: Adam and Dog, full version
content: The Academy Award-nominated animated short "Adam and Dog" has been released in its full 15-minute run time on YouTube.(Direct link to YouTube video) The director,Minkyu Leesays, "This is a short film that me and a group of my close friends made. It was put together by artists who work at various studios, including Disney Feature, Dreamworks and Pixar; The animation is done by myself, Jennifer Hager, James Baxter, Mario Furmanczyk, Austin Madison, and Matt Williames. Glen Keane also helped by being a consultant on the film, and also doing some visual development. It is a completely independent film without any major studio involvement. We are really excited for people to see it, and wanted to share.”
